initial_query: Multipart upload files are cleaned up after successful requests, but remain open when request validation fails or the endpoint raises after the form has been parsed. Make form-owned files close reliably on all request exit paths without changing the endpoint's status codes, validation behavior, or normal file handling.

feedback_by_state.primary: An uploaded file is still left open when the endpoint raises after form parsing.
feedback_by_state.edge: Uploaded files are still not closed when validation fails after the multipart form has already been parsed.
feedback_by_state.exception: The cleanup change altered the original HTTP error or validation response semantics.
feedback_by_state.regression: Normal successful multipart requests no longer close their uploaded files exactly as before.

success_condition: All hidden grader states pass: primary, edge, exception, regression.
